rules.condition: a byte is accepted at edge E0 (handshake)
rules.statement: The start bit must appear on o_txd in the first cycle after the accepting handshake edge E0.

rules.condition: a byte is accepted at edge E0
rules.statement: The transmit frame must last 10N cycles, with the stop bit ending at edge E0+10N.

rules.condition: a byte is accepted at edge E0
rules.statement: o_tx_ready must be 0 for 10N-1 cycles after E0 and become 1 in the last cycle of the stop bit.

rules.condition: o_tx_ready = 0 while a byte is offered
rules.statement: The block must never drop an offered byte while o_tx_ready = 0; the upstream block waits.
The transmitter must accept one byte every 10N cycles and produce a continuous stream of frames with no idle cycle between them.
Bytes must be sent on o_txd in the order in which they were accepted.

rules.condition: a stop bit is followed at once by the next start bit, each bit N cycles long
rules.statement: The receiver must accept frames back to back with no idle bit between them.
Delivery must occur at V = T0 + H + 9N + 2 edges, which is 2 edges after the stop-bit sample M.

rules.condition: two start bits are spaced at least H + 9N + 1 cycles apart
rules.statement: The receiver must detect a start bit at the smallest spacing of H + 9N + 1 cycles, so a slightly fast transmitter is accepted.

rules.condition: at delivery V the holding register is full and i_rx_ready = 0
rules.statement: After V, o_rx_overrun must be 1 for one cycle and the held byte must remain unchanged.
